# Installation recommendation

Proceed with an inert draft PR for this approved master-only pilot after review. Keep .yml.template and both enable variables off. Do not activate until the trust boundaries, dedicated model secret, current model pricing, durable ledger initialization and branch/environment protections are checked.

Budget is a conservative, irreversible USD1 reservation per workflow attempt, 100/month. Separate writer/reviewer/publisher jobs minimize secret access. Repository-local ledger needs trusted protected writers; it is not an adversarial administrator-proof billing service. The remaining controls are substantive activation blockers, not optional documentation.

After protected setup: review-only smoke push, inspect result and budget reservation, then approve one controlled publication test before wider use. No code can guarantee bug-finding quality; public issues must be described as unverified AI candidates.
